Built a playable boxing game in `index.html`.

It includes a 3D ring and original boxers, keyboard and touch controls, jab/hook/uppercut/guard mechanics, stamina and damage, three-round matches with a between-round cutman mini-game, sparring mode, same-device local versus, boxer customization, and gym training progression.

Assumptions: fighters and venues are original rather than likenesses of real athletes. Multiplayer is local on a shared keyboard; online matchmaking isn’t implemented. The game uses Three.js from a CDN, so it needs an internet connection to load.

Validation: the game script passes `node --check`. I couldn’t verify the browser rendering because the Playwright Chromium browser isn’t installed in this environment.
